name: Sakway
summary: Contact goes by "Sakway" (likely an artist/stage name — he identified himself twice as "This Sakway" / "Call me this Sakway") and appears to run the Instagram account "GLACIER 🧊 BOY IZZY ❄️" (#REALGLACIER). Started as a casual contact in May 2026 trying to link up in person, then on June 20, 2026 sent screenshots of an Instagram suspension and a Meta copyright/IP takedown notice and asked "How much to get page back." No price was quoted in the thread and the owner never replied to the pricing question; on June 22 he said "Imma sendup" (implying payment) and on June 27 asked for a call. Follow-up: quote an IG account recovery/appeal price and call him back — the suspension has a 180-day appeal window from June 20, 2026 (expires ~Dec 17, 2026).
